title: BNDS.life
description: At the start of his final year at university, he spent spare moments revisiting old videos from his senior year of high school. Those days with friends still meant a great deal to him, prompting him to gather the footage onto a publicly accessible website where everyone could return to it together. He built the core features of BNDS.life in one week in September 2026, and the project is now largely complete. Inspired by YouTube’s browsing and playback design, he organized a year’s worth of memories into longer videos grouped by month and short clips in a continuous vertical feed—both with space for written stories so the memories behind the footage stay alongside the videos.
role: Project concept, website design and development, video curation and deployment
